problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals, often executives, to gain access to sensitive data or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing campaigns
Educate high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email accounts for unusual sending patterns or login locations

problems.description: Misconfigured cloud storage buckets or services exposing sensitive data publicly or to unauthorized users, leading to data breaches or leakage.
risk_reduction: Implement automated configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies and role-based access control
Use cloud provider security posture management (CSPM) tools

problems.description: Attackers compromise software or hardware suppliers to insert malicious code or backdoors, impacting downstream customers and organizations.
risk_reduction: Conduct thorough vendor risk assessments and continuous monitoring
Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and code signing
Adopt zero trust principles for third-party access

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade AI/ML system performance or cause misclassification.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust training techniques and anomaly detection on model behavior
Implement continuous monitoring of AI/ML outputs

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio, video) to impersonate trusted individuals in phishing or social engineering attacks.
risk_reduction: Train users to recognize deepfake indicators
Deploy AI-based detection tools for synthetic media
Enforce multi-factor verification for sensitive transactions

problems.description: Attackers not only encrypt victim data but also exfiltrate it, threatening to release sensitive information publicly if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Maintain offline and tested backups
Implement network segmentation and strict access controls
Use endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools with behavioral analytics
